q1_issues.issue: The purpose adjunct 'for time-keeping' is attached to the object KIND (notched_candle), which asserts a standing kind-level purpose of notched candles at large instead of the purpose the clause states for the carrying.
A contingent kind-level claim between two bare kinds carries (STV 1.0 0.99); the confidence dial reaches every kind-level claim whatever its head, so this should be confidence 0.9.

q2_gaps: an adjunct (purpose / manner / time PP) on a relational generic: the kind relation is an opaque two-slot atom with no slot for it, and only the adjectivally-restricted SUBJECT case is legislated (that one forces the distributing-rule route instead)

decomposition of an action / gerund nominalization compound ('time-keeping'): the compound rules cover verb_object compound actions, modifier_noun kinds and agent nominalizations, none of which fits, so the symbol is left whole with no stated licence
notes: The bare-plural/bare-plural relational-generic route and its 0.9/0.9 TV are right, as is exposing the participial modifier's genus by the predication test. Fusing 'notched candles' into notched_candle is defensible as a genuine subtype, though the instruction set's own participial example ('a laminated worktop') is left unfused.
